title: 691. Bulb Switcher II

examples.explanation: One lamp can end on or off after one press.
With two lamps, one press yields three reachable patterns.
With at least three lamps, one press yields four patterns.

hints: Only the first three lamps matter; further lamps repeat the same behavior pattern.
Enumerate the four button effects and notice presses beyond a small bound stop creating new states.
Handle n = 1 and n = 2 separately, then use the capped table 1, 4, 7, 8 for n >= 3.
